d:
Expedition Unknown takes Josh Gates deep into the ancient Maya city of El Mirador in Guatemala, where he sets out to uncover the lost tombs of a mysterious ruling dynasty known as the Snake Kings. Surrounded by towering pyramids, ancient monuments and clues from a long-lost civilisation, Josh investigates whether the final resting places of these powerful rulers are still hidden beneath the jungle. Can he uncover the secrets of the legendary Snake Kings?
Watch Expedition Unknown, Season 4, Episode 3, on Discovery Channel India.
